description: Scheduled (future) flights between two airports in a date window via the official FlightAware AeroAPI /schedules endpoint: ident, operator, scheduled out/in times and aircraft type per flight. Use it to see what actually flies a route on given days; it returns no prices. Requires the FLIGHTAWARE_API_KEY secret; each call bills AeroAPI usage.

date_end.description: Window end date, YYYY-MM-DD (exclusive per AeroAPI semantics).

destination.description: Destination airport IATA or ICAO code.

max_pages.description: AeroAPI pagination cap — how many result pages to fetch (each page bills separately). Default 1.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh AeroAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

origin.description: Origin airport IATA or ICAO code (e.g. WAW or EPWA).

name: flightaware_search_scheduled
title: FlightAware scheduled flights on a route (AeroAPI)
